scope: ACTUAL LIVE704spiking/80graded controller, not motor-wave replay.216logical chemical pathways use population-mean filtered spike readouts; source and target populations broadcast shared activation. Do not invent784x784independent synapses or divide conductance without preserving the shared saturating decoder.12PF/RG calcium-LIF populations and16sensory LIF populations replace their graded channel outputs. Population proxies are not soma voltages. Named type variants retain exact effective G/Erev/threshold/saturation after runtime calibration. explicit_display_aliases.reason: Source duplicate L-labelled Renshaw cell has right-side actual neighbours. Display alias only; source and numerical indices unchanged.

population_readout_contract.shared_gate: Per logical chemical path: G*clip((proxy−threshold)/(saturation−threshold),0,1), then broadcast to each target membrane; global saturation prevents arbitrary replacement by independently clipped all-to-all synapses.
